question: What functional unit does the life-cycle assessment of resource recovery from spent FCC catalysts use, and in what software and with what primary impact assessment method were impacts calculated?
expect: treatment of 1 t of spent FCC catalyst; SimaPro 10.1 with Environmental Footprint (EF) 3.1 (adapted) (abstract; sec. 2)
trap: ReCiPe 2016 (used only for a supplementary comparison)
rendered:
Document: Environmental and Preliminary Economic Assessment of Integrated Resource Recovery from Spent Fluid Catalytic Cracking Catalysts, page 1

The life-cycle assessment of resource recovery from spent FCC catalysts uses the treatment of 1 t of spent FCC catalyst as the functional unit. The impacts were calculated in SimaPro 10.1 using Environmental Footprint 3.1 (adapted) as the primary life-cycle impact assessment method, complemented by an operating-level cost assessment, sensitivity analysis, and scenario analysis.
